services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water pouring through your ceiling? We locate and repair burst pipes fast, minimising damage to your home. Call anytime—we're ready.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Breakdowns
services.desc: Boiler won't ignite? Strange noises or leaks? Most faults diagnosed and fixed same day, with parts carried on the van.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: New condensing boilers cut heating bills by up to 30% and come with 10-year warranties. We fit and commission the lot.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your heating running safely and efficiently through winter. Includes safety checks and full system inspection.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Cold patches? Leaking joints? We bleed, repair, or replace radiators—often while you wait.

services.title: Pipework & System Installation
services.desc: New bathrooms, kitchen remodels, or system extensions. We lay pipework, fit isolating valves, and balance your system for even heat.

about_pullquote: We fixed my emergency at midnight and didn't overcharge me. That's how we do business.
about_para_1: Lilarch Plumbing & Heating has served Hull families and businesses for over 15 years. We started because too many locals were being let down by cowboys and overpriced emergency call-outs. Today, we handle everything from burst pipes at 2am to full heating system replacements, and we're Gas Safe registered and fully insured.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up fast, diagnosing honestly, and fixing problems right the first time. We carry parts on the van, so most repairs are done the same day. Hundreds of Hull homeowners come back to us year after year because they know we'll treat their home with respect and give them a fair price.
reviews_heading: What Hull Homeowners Say About Lilarch

reviews.text: Woke up at 2am to water dripping through the kitchen ceiling. Rang Lilarch and they were here within 45 minutes. Steve found the burst pipe under the floorboards, fixed it, and even helped mop up. Absolutely brilliant service. Will use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in right before Christmas. Dreaded what it might cost, but Lilarch came same day, diagnosed a faulty pump, and had us back up and running by evening. Fair price too. Can't ask for better than that.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: Had a slow leak in the bathroom radiator for months. Mentioned it to a mate and he recommended Lilarch. They came, spotted a dodgy valve, replaced it in 30 minutes. No fuss, no mess, great bloke. Definitely calling them for the boiler service next month.
reviews.author: David P.
